name: AUTOPILOT.OI Video Agent
description_html:
Your TikTok video agent: one idea in, a week of videos planned.

A Claude agent that finds the patterns in your niche from videos you paste, plans 7 videos a week, writes scripts in your voice, turns each one into a cut by cut CapCut edit plan, writes the caption and hashtags, turns comments into new ideas and reviews your numbers every Friday.

What you get (14 page agent pack, PDF): a setup builder that installs the agent with you in about 30 minutes, 12 setup questions, full agent instructions with 9 commands, the worked example from our reel, a hook bank, an edit plan template and a 30 day video tracker.

How it works: it runs inside a Claude Project. It plans and writes. You film and edit in CapCut and decide what posts. It does not edit video files, post without your OK, or promise views.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works), your phone and CapCut (free).

Education only. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic, TikTok or CapCut.
